_comment: Dynamic README metrics from gitignored or volatile sources (fallow health score, Vitest line/branch coverage, source LOC, inline-suppression counts, built content.js size). Refreshed by `pnpm gen:readme --refresh`, which `pnpm metrics` runs after fallow + coverage + the content-bundle guard; committed so the README guard recomputes the badge block without running any tool, and so unrelated commits don't drift it. `loc` and `suppressions` come from one tool-free scan of apps/ + packages/, so `pnpm gen:readme --refresh-source` can refresh just those two in well under a second. Both are held to reality by check 5 of the metrics gate (loc within a 500-line band, suppression counts exactly) — see docs/metrics-gate.md; nothing checks the health score or bundle size, which are point-in-time. Truly-static metrics (permissions, license) and live-verified promises are computed in scripts/gen-readme-metrics.mts and are NOT stored here.
